summary: Reproduce Cargo source component reuse on pinned NL code

delivery.outcome: Reproduce source-only Rust producer and isolated Python NL consumer with committed developer pilot, canonical documentation and independent protected merge.
nonGoals: No runtime/backend/algorithm/ABI/schema/runtime dependency/platform changes, consumer repository edits, downloads, speed guarantee, registry release or deployment.

architecture.decision: Add optional source-rust-component pilot mode requiring prebuilt-rust/build-wheelhouse and excluding repack mode. Snapshot exact committed kernel source; production sorust.rust_backend builds native source sdist then wheel in offline isolated environments without Cython wheel inputs. Share input snapshot/fresh frontend and tool policy with consumer mode; assert native producer frontend absence and exact source provenance. Consumer declares generated native wheel dependency and uses Rust-free isolated build. Report actual donor manifest and check bytes/C ABI/export/NL24/rlib; preserve all prior modes.
dataChanges: Additive pilot report producer provenance, existing manifest schema unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert; preserve previous modes/artifacts and ignored run outputs.

validation.evidence: Mode guards before input effects, stale native backend, source pin/filter safety, actual producer and isolated consumer evidence.
Full suites, actual pinned NL24/source sdist-wheel/Cython-free producer/Rust-free consumer/standalone/metadata/C ABI/rlib; canonicalv23 indexed and pinned Docs check.
Exact-head local/remote checks and independent approval/merge, postmerge artifacts and current owner release/preserved cleanup.
